notes.title: Abunka BETA Testing
notes.content:
[h1]Abunka Trailer[/h1]


[previewyoutube=JkdyeqG4-TU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]We are proud to announce that we are starting to accept requests from people to join our Abunka playtest event.[/h3]

[h2]ABUNKA is a pc MOBA inspired 3 vs 3 strategic action brawler with a distinguished shooting and building mechanics Armed with special weapons and abilities, the warriors start their training for the epic battles ahead, all together to save the life on “ and bring back peace[/h2]

[h3]You can request to join on this  link: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/888420/Abunka/]Abunka Playtest[/url][/h3]

[h3]We will announce the server opening times and dates during this month. stay connected!

You can join us for quick updates on our social channels:

[b]Facebook:[/b] [url=https://www.facebook.com/Abunkagame]Abunka[/url]

[b]Instagram:[/b] [url=https://www.instagram.com/abunkagame/]Abunka[/url]

[b]Discord:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/SWjpyTQXpH]Join our Discord[/url]

We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield![/h3]
